accessCertificationDefinition.name: Contoso T2 requestable-access review
accessCertificationDefinition.description: ADR 0012 tier T2, the branch for requestable access with NO expiry (these role assignments carry no validTo, so the 180-day expiry that normally certifies T2 does not apply): requestable business roles, manager review, unanswered = removed. The halfyearly cadence and mandatory justification are not modelled in this one-off run. Managed by run-campaign.sh.

scopeDefinition.name: Requestable business roles of enabled users

stageDefinition.name: Manager review
stageDefinition.description: Can this person still justify this access? If you are unsure, revoke: they can request it again.

reviewerSpecification.name: Holder's manager, fallback: access governance lead
